items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Lester Bowie was interviewed one time and he said... that’s when they started the AACM.

ctx.x: Lester Bowie. Lester Bowie was interviewed one time and he said, “Yeah man, we realized, we reached a point where we realized that man if we’re going to get respect for our music, we’re going to have to organize ourselves, because nobody’s going to do it for us.” You know? And that’s when they started the AACM.
Well this has been a fascinating conversation. I’m so glad we had the opportunity. I want to thank you for your time and your — how well you speak about your music and everything that goes with it.
